name: swarm-join-cloud-config-alpine
stdout:
#cloud-config
#
# pstack swarm WORKER — joins the manager at 10.0.0.1:2377.
# Rendered by pstack <VERSION> for alpine. Boot a machine with it; nothing to run afterwards.
#
# ── FIREWALL, BEFORE YOU BOOT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Between this machine and every other node (the manager included):
#     2377/tcp       cluster management (worker → manager)
#     7946/tcp+udp   node discovery (every node ↔ every node)
#     4789/udp       overlay network traffic — VXLAN (every node ↔ every node)
#
# ── THIS FILE HOLDS THE JOIN TOKEN ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Whoever has it can add a node that runs any task on the cluster. Rotate it from the manager
# with `docker swarm join-token --rotate worker` if this file leaks.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

groups:
  - docker

users:
  - default
  - name: preview
    gecos: preview stack operator
    shell: /bin/bash
    groups: [docker]
    sudo: 'ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL'
    lock_passwd: true
    # No key here: the provider injects its own at boot (e.g. `hcloud server create --ssh-key`).

package_update: true
packages:
  - ca-certificates
  - curl
  - bash
  - sudo

runcmd:
  # ── 1. Docker ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - apk add --no-cache docker docker-cli-compose docker-cli-buildx
  - rc-update add docker boot
  - service docker start
  - docker --version
  # ── 2. Join ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - docker swarm join --token SWMTKN-1-abc-def 10.0.0.1:2377
  - docker info --format 'joined as {{.Swarm.NodeID}} ({{.Swarm.LocalNodeState}})'

final_message: |
  swarm worker is up after $UPTIME seconds — joined 10.0.0.1:2377.
  Check from the manager: docker node ls
stderr:
This is a SECRET — whoever has it can add a node that runs any task on this
  swarm. Rotate it with `docker swarm join-token --rotate worker`.
  Open 2377/tcp, 7946/tcp+udp, 4789/udp between every pair of nodes.
